summary: Reference-only: drinking removes the need for sleep and prevents magical sleep for 24 hours.
text: Reference-only: drinking removes the need for sleep and prevents magical sleep for 24 hours. During this time, a Long Rest takes 4 hours of conscious, quiet focus.
